lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: two dollar signs, a sunset and a promotion. not one sigh out of me. the gulls can stay

lines.speaker: liam
lines.text: sitting out over the water with a scoop nobody dropped. this one's for that kid

lines.speaker: roxy
lines.text: fruit, ice, zero milk, happy stomach. sherbet who??

lines.speaker: cyrus
lines.text: Crushed peanuts on the topping tray, and a peanut-butter swirl churned in the same machine as every other flavour. It's everything I described earlier. I'm not ordering.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: my first funded night out and we walk cyrus into a peanut minefield?? i'm literally leaving this chat, and i'm taking all of you with me

lines.speaker: roxy
lines.text: toppings were MY idea. i'm so sorry cyrus. we're going, right now

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: gorgeous. three-dollar-sign gorgeous. i'm sighing at this bill and look, the gulls are leaving. exactly as promised

lines.speaker: brooke
lines.text: funded, not rich. we heard you, maya! two signs next time, i'll hold everyone to it

lines.speaker: roxy
lines.text: i ordered the sorbet like a responsible adult. turns out it's sherbet with a fancy label. my stomach was not fooled

lines.speaker: cyrus
lines.text: I should have read their small print for you. Sit down, Roxy. Water's on me.

lines.speaker: liam
lines.text: great granita. stuck indoors on the last hot night of summer. the one thing i said i wouldn't do

lines.speaker: brooke
lines.text: then we finish them on a walk down the boardwalk. the sunset isn't over yet!

lines.speaker: brooke
lines.text: a fried doughnut, three scoops stuffed inside, hot fudge and brownie on top. it's the housewarming all over again

lines.speaker: liam
lines.text: i'll help you finish it. purely as a favour

lines.speaker: liam
lines.text: lovely little pasta place. but i've been thinking about that kid's scoop all day, and this is not that

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: dinner at two signs still counts as a celebration. we're finding liam a scoop on the walk home
